title: Baldej Delights
description: Farmer's delight add-on inspired by low-internet cuisine
body:
![Baldej Delights](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da78711a8a6b295783695654916445a57ca7c330.png)
Baldej Delights is an Farmer's delight add-on that inspired by russian low-internet meme cuisine

# Features
## New food:
- Onion frenzy 
- Apples in chicken broth
- Egg barbecue
- Bobs
- Fried nails
- Overcooked pancakes
- Tomato with maltese cross
- Four meat pie

## New effects:
- Disappointment, an effect, that reduces food value by quarter.
- Tomato Blessing, an effect, that gives a chance to refund the consumed food item.

# Compatibility
This mod adds several custom Create recipes.

# Special Thanks
Thanks to Kaupenjoe for [one of the best neoforge modding tutorials](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yG-oJPR_40w&list=PLKGarocXCE1G6CQOoiYdMVx-E1d9F_itF&index=1)

# Permission
You are free to use this mod in your modpack, but i would appreciate some credits.
